name: science-data
description: Science data pack: a skill that finds datasets and keeps results in the store, reads HDF5, NetCDF, Parquet and CSV with Clio's data tool first, and declares the clio-kit parquet and pandas MCP servers with per-tool action classes for analysis beyond it. Read tools run without asking; file-writing tools ask first; each server needs one online launch to build its environment before it runs offline.
